done_when: The 'Releasing Forge' section of docs/guide.md says: cut once a day at 05:00 UTC from the newest main commit whose Linux full run and Windows run passed; the contents are frozen at the cut and only a fix without which the release is unsafe or its checks cannot pass may join; later work waits for the next day; publish within 30 minutes of the cut without a separate owner yes; skip the day when nothing merged or main is red
why: Forge releases wait on scope added during the release: v1.2.44 waited about 20 hours while four fixes were added after the cut; the owner chose on 20 Nov 2026 one release a day from green main, with frozen contents, published without a separate owner yes
